description: Ask one live Mixlayer model and save its answer, token use, and cost in the local ledger. Preview before sending sensitive input.

dry_run.description: Preview the request without sending model data or spending credits

model.description: Model ID selected from the live models_list result

question.description: The question or task to send to the selected model

name: ask

description: Create a chat completion for the given model and messages. Required: model, messages. Optional: tools, tool_choice, temperature (plus 3 more).

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

messages.description: List of messages comprising the conversation so far

model.description: ID of the model to use (e.g. qwen/qwen3.5-4b-free)

stream.description: Whether to stream back partial progress

tool_choice.description: Controls which tool, if any, the model calls

tools.description: List of tools the model may call

name: chat_create_completion

description: Read the embedded Mixlayer Agent Skill and runtime guidance before choosing a model or sending private data.
name: context

description: Check Mixlayer authentication, API reachability, and resolved local paths; report missing credentials without revealing them.
name: doctor

description: Start with cheaper live models and climb only when an answer is insufficiently confident; save the trial ledger locally.

dry_run.description: Preview the request without sending model data or spending credits

question.description: The question or task to send to the selected model

rungs.description: Comma-separated live model IDs; default uses the live catalog

name: escalate

description: Run the same question across selected Mixlayer model rungs to compare answers, latency, reasoning, and cost.

dry_run.description: Preview the request without sending model data or spending credits

question.description: The question or task to send to the selected model

rungs.description: Comma-separated live model IDs; default uses the live catalog

name: ladder

description: Retrieve a model by ID. Required: id.

id.description: Model ID from models_list, e.g. qwen/qwen3.5-9b

name: models_get

description: List currently available Mixlayer models and live prices when the platform provides them; use this before selecting a model.

dry_run.description: Preview the request without sending model data or spending credits

live_prices.description: Fetch live organization prices when available; defaults to true

name: models_list

description: Mask question and file data before an explicit upstream model call, run the outbound tripwire, and return a local restoration receipt.

detector.description: regex, local:<model>, or mixlayer:<model>; use a model for external upstreams

dry_run.description: Preview the request without sending model data or spending credits

model.description: Model ID selected from the live models_list result

question.description: The question or task to send to the selected model

upstream.description: Explicit upstream: mixlayer, openai, anthropic, openrouter, or custom

upstream_base_url.description: Base URL for a custom upstream

upstream_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding a custom upstream key; never pass its value

name: shield_ask

description: Mask personal data in a local file and populate the local reversible vault; dry run reports the planned operation without touching the vault.

dry_run.description: Preview the request without sending model data or spending credits

file.description: Path to the local file to redact

name: shield_redact

description: Run read-only SQL over the local run ledger: what was asked, which model answered, tokens, latency and cost. The private vault is not readable here.

query.description: A single SELECT or WITH query. Tables: runs(id, group_id, command, prompt, answer, reasoning, model, seed, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, latency_ms, created_at), audit (shield receipts), ladders, models_cache. Example: SELECT model, count(*), sum(cost_usd) FROM runs GROUP BY model.

name: sql
